📖 How to use

  1. Enter your page title, URL and meta description.
  2. See the Google-style preview update live.
  3. Check the desktop (600 px) and mobile (360 px) widths.
  4. Fix any warnings: keep titles under ~600 px and descriptions under ~920 px.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why show pixel widths instead of just characters?

Google truncates by pixel width, not characters — wide letters like "W" take more space. The pixel estimates here use canvas text measurement with Arial, close to Google's font, but Google's exact rendering can differ slightly.

What are the safe limits?

Roughly 60 characters / 600 px for titles and 155–160 characters / ~920 px for descriptions. Exceed them and Google truncates with an ellipsis.

Will my page look exactly like this on Google?

Yes — this is a visual approximation of Google's layout. Google sometimes rewrites titles and descriptions, so the live result may differ.
